text:
Olivia: Quick thread  Denver LLM Summit confirmed Aug 22. We have a 20\" table, two 8-minute demo slots, and a 15-min lightning round. Need owners for talk submission, demo flow, swag, shipping, and lead routing. Shipping cutoff Aug 10. Who can take talk submission today?

Sam: I can file the talk. Planning a short demo that shows latency vs cost with live toggles for batching/quant. Will keep code off slides except one tiny snippet. Need slide limit?

Priya: Stickers + postcards + 100 branded notebooks proposal. Vendor: mountain-swag.io. PO #PO-6532. ETA Aug 16. Notebooks pushed budget a bit. Recommend postcards 100 -> 60 to stay flat.

Diego: I can do AV and be onsite lead. Request: 13\" monitor, HDMI + USB-C dongles, 2 lavs, power strip. I'll draft an arrival checklist.

Marta: Lead capture idea: QR -> short form (Airtable) + badge scanner fallback. Route to HubSpot list "Denver Summit" -> assign to Diego for 72h -> then SDR. I'll own the form and Zap.

ops-bot: Venue note: Summit Hall B. Arrival window Aug 22 7:30-8:30am. Tables supply[1] limited; confirm footprint 6ft x 2.5ft.

Olivia: Decision: stickers 250, postcards 60, notebooks 100. Priya please finalize PO and set hold-for-pickup. I also want a one-page leave-behind: micro-benchmark + 3 integration tips. Sam, can you draft that by Aug 8?

Sam: Yes. Will include a small chart (2-token baseline vs 1k-tail) and three practical tips (batching, cache prefixes, model selection). Need latest perf PNG.

ops-bot: Perf upload: https://drive.re/redwood/bench/denver_aug22_tail.png

Priya: Shipping contact: RockyShip Logistics, tracking RS7654321. I'll set recipient to "Olivia / Redwood Inference" and confirm hold. PO and invoice will be uploaded to the event sheet.

Marta: Zapier draft for leads:
```
trigger: airtable.new_record
action: POST https://api.hubspot.com/contacts/v1/contact
payload: {"properties":[{"property":"email","value":"{{Email}}"},{"property":"utm_source","value":"denver_summit"},{"property":"owner","value":"Diego"}]}
```
I'll test with a sandbox entry and report results.

Diego: Layout plan: monitor in center, postcards left, stickers top-right, notebooks under table. I'll be onsite contact and will handle badge scanner and lead triage.

Olivia: Dry run Aug 20 @ 10am MST. Recap owners: Sam = talk + one-pager, Priya = swag + shipping, Marta = lead form + zap, Diego = AV + onsite. I'll send calendar invites and a one-page runbook template. Please add any contraints to the sheet. :rocket:
